4863.about: In an office a woman sticks a green sticky note onto a square of a huge wall calendar, then sits and writes in a colour-tabbed planner. She adds more notes to the calendar, and the wall grows into an enormous grid covered with hundreds of coloured notes while she stands with her hands on her hips looking up at it.
4863.question: What is the woman writing in?
4863.answer: She is writing in a notebook.

4864.about: A young woman works at a laptop in a bright home office and raises one finger asking for quiet as she talks. Behind her a young man slips past the doorway, then another man carries a box through. Then an entire marching band files into the room in matching navy, orange and light blue uniforms, playing trumpets, a trombone, a sousaphone and a bass drum. She throws her hands up and shouts in disbelief while the band plays on around her desk.

phrases.target: the man in the black T-shirt

4864.question: What is the second man carrying?
4864.answer: He is carrying a big box.

4865.about: A young photographer kneels on sunlit grass in a park and aims a big camera with a long lens straight at the viewer. He then crouches in a city garden to photograph a pink rose from close up, skyscrapers behind him. A close shot shows the camera's rear screen with a sunset over a city, the camera sitting on a tripod. The sunset view fills the frame over the tripod. At night on a red carpet in a crowd he lifts the camera and grins.
4865.question: What is the photographer photographing up close?
4865.answer: He is photographing a delicate pink rose.

4866.about: A man walks through Times Square holding a phone on a gimbal and filming himself. In a film studio a hand holds a clapperboard reading ACTION in front of a cinema camera on a tripod under a large softbox. A white drone with four propellers hovers low over a green field, flattening the grass beneath it. An aerial shot glides over rolling green and yellow farmland. Back in the studio the crew claps and cheers behind a camera operator.
4866.question: What is the drone doing?
4866.answer: The drone is hovering low over the field.

4867.about: A montage of people making videos. A young man in a gaming chair with a headset shouts happily at a ring light, a lit keyboard in front of him. A woman in a kitchen holds up a big pan of chicken and vegetables toward the camera. A girl on a sofa laughs and holds both thumbs up close to the lens. A young man sings loudly into a studio microphone with an electric guitar. Finally a performer stands on a huge arena stage with arms raised, confetti falling, filmed by two camera operators.

phrases.en: to hold up a frying pan
to sing with his eyes closed

4867.question: What is the girl doing?
4867.answer: She is giving two thumbs up.

4868.about: A laptop on a desk shows lines of green code in a dark editor. A young man in a hoodie clenches his fist and cheers at his screen. He then sits at a two-monitor desk in an open office, typing code with both hands. In a dark room a whole team stands in front of a wall of monitors filled with code. When a huge green check mark appears on the central screen, the whole team throws their arms up and cheers.

phrases.en: to point at the laptop screen
phrases.target: the woman in the denim shirt

phrases.en: to appear on the main screen

4868.question: What is the woman in denim doing?
4868.answer: She is pointing at the laptop screen.

4869.about: A young woman with curly hair draws a swirling logo letter on a tablet with a stylus at a sunny desk. She then stands over a table fanned out with dozens of colour swatch cards and smiles at the camera. At an iMac she arranges a colourful poster layout with a colour wheel open beside it. A hand turns a sketchbook page showing a pencil drawing of a woman in a long flowing gown. Finally she poses in front of a huge colourful mural in a gallery while visitors look at it.
4869.question: What is the woman drawing on?
4869.answer: She is drawing on a tablet.

4870.about: Close up, a man's face is covered in thick white shaving foam and he draws a straight razor down his cheek, leaving a clean stripe. In a bathroom mirror he trims his beard with an electric trimmer. In a barbershop a barber shaves his beard line with a straight razor while he sits under a white cape. By a swimming pool a bare forearm with a white stripe of foam is shaved smooth. Finally he sits grinning in the barber chair while four men around him applaud.
4870.question: What is the barber doing?
4870.answer: He is leaning over the customer.

4871.about: A close shot shows a hand writing a name into a spiral-bound book headed REGISTRATION, with other names already filled in. Two smiling staff in lanyards hand a printed name badge across the counter to a guest. Behind the desk more staff work with stacks of forms, badge printers and card scanners while a queue waits. The camera pulls back to show an enormous convention hall with a huge crowd lined up at long check-in tables.

phrases.en: to hand over a name badge

4871.question: What is the woman with glasses doing?
4871.answer: She is handing a name badge to the guest.

4872.about: A woman in a leather cap and khaki jacket sits at a table set with small bowls of food, holding a clipboard and a pen. She stamps rows of stars onto small white cards with a rubber stamp and holds one up, wide-eyed. The table fills with dozens of cards each showing five stars, some black and some gold. The final wide shot reveals the table and the whole wall behind her covered with hundreds of identical five-star cards.

phrases.en: to write with a blue pen

4872.question: What is the woman doing?
4872.answer: She is stamping stars on cards.

4873.about: A woman with glasses pushed up on her head sits at a desk walled in by towering stacks of books and bundles of paper. She reads an open book, writes on a small sticky note and looks up in surprise. The camera pulls back and the stacks keep growing until she is a tiny figure in the middle of a wall of books and files reaching the ceiling.

phrases.en: to scribble on a sticky note
to hold up a sticky note

4873.question: What is the woman doing?
4873.answer: She is scribbling on a sticky note.

4874.about: A cyclist in a yellow jersey and a white-and-yellow helmet is stopped at a big city junction, mouth open in shock; above and beside her a traffic light shows green and amber. The camera pulls back and pedestrians, runners and a dog stream across the striped crossing in front of her while tall buildings rise on both sides.
4874.question: What is the dog doing?
4874.answer: The dog is crossing the street.

4875.about: Outside a suburban house a woman in work gloves carries a cardboard box down the drive past a wall of stacked boxes, then a tower of five boxes. Behind her a large white box truck stands open with a ramp down; she and two other movers slide boxes and a brown leather sofa up the ramp into the truck's cargo hold, which is already packed with boxes.
4875.question: What is the woman in shorts doing?
4875.answer: She is carrying boxes to the truck.

4877.about: A woman in a cream jumper and jeans is seated alone in a padded seat in an empty auditorium, blowing out a breath. As the camera pulls back, more and more people are seated in the rows around and behind her, until the whole vast hall is full of people sitting quietly in their seats, all facing the same way.

phrases.en: to lean back in her seat

phrases.target: the man in the front row

4877.question: What is the woman in white doing?
4877.answer: She is sitting in her seat.

4878.about: A young man in swim shorts dives head first off the end of a wooden platform that runs out from the shore over a green lake, and hits the water with a big splash. He surfaces in the ring of foam, two more people plunge in, and then a long platform on posts over turquoise water appears, lined with dozens of teenagers who all jump off it together.
4878.question: What are the teenagers doing?
4878.answer: They are leaping off the pier.

4879.about: At an outdoor strength contest a woman in a black lifting suit and belt presses a loaded barbell overhead, then hauls a huge grey stone up to her chest and above her head. Next she balances a thick length of tree trunk, bark still on and the sawn end showing, across her shoulders, and finally holds a small black car over her head while the crowd watches from behind a rope.
4879.question: What is the weightlifter doing?
4879.answer: She is lifting heavy objects in a competition.

4880.about: From the edge of a tall rooftop the camera looks straight down at a car park deck far below, where a small blue water balloon falls and bursts. A grinning young man leans over the parapet holding a watermelon with the city skyline behind him, drops it, and it splatters on the concrete. Then a sack bursts on the deck and finally he tips a big water bottle over the edge and it explodes into spray far below.
4880.question: What is the man doing?
4880.answer: He is dropping a bottle from the roof.

4881.about: A woman braces her hands against the back of a small silver car and shoves it along the street. The shot widens and a line of people is pushing the back of a long city bus, number 230, with its destination sign lit, along the road; then a group pushes the back of a lorry trailer, and finally a whole row of people leans into an enormous round boulder in the road.
4881.question: What are the people doing?
4881.answer: They are pushing a big bus.

4882.about: A line of people in matching gym kit hauls on a thick rope across a mown field, teeth gritted, dragging a wooden sled loaded with people, then an old saloon car. The scene cuts to an airfield where the same line of people pulls the rope hand over hand and drags a huge grey military transport plane, with four jet engines under its wings, along the tarmac towards the camera.
4882.question: What are the people doing?
4882.answer: They are dragging an aircraft along the tarmac.

4883.about: A woman in a bright floral sundress walks smiling down a pale hallway; tall carved wooden double doors appear; she strides through the vaulted hall of an Italian villa with her arms flung wide; she pushes two huge studded wooden doors apart, steps outside, and the open doors show a sunlit valley of green hills behind her.
4883.question: What is the woman doing?
4883.answer: She is opening two big doors.

4884.about: A young woman standing in a crowd stares upward and points one finger at the sky; the people beside her raise their arms and point at the same spot; the camera pulls back over an old city square where hundreds of people all point straight up together.

phrases.en: to point at the sky first

4884.question: What are the people doing?
4884.answer: They are pointing at the sky.

4885.about: A woman in a beige utility vest holds a small rainbow flag up high and walks up a sunny cobbled street in an old Italian hill town; stone houses with shutters and balconies line both sides, and a long line of people follows her up the street.

phrases.en: to hold up a small flag

4885.question: What is the woman doing?
4885.answer: She is walking along the street.

4886.about: A young man with a large backpack and trekking poles pushes his way up a steep grassy mountain path; the camera follows him from behind and then from the front while the slope falls away below him to a wide alpine valley and rows of distant peaks.
4886.question: What is the hiker doing?
4886.answer: He is climbing a steep slope.

4887.about: A hiker in a cap and backpack climbs down a red rock canyon trail; the camera looks along his boots as he steps from ledge to ledge, then opens onto huge layered sandstone cliffs and a thin stony path winding down into the gorge between the rock walls.
4887.question: What is the hiker doing?
4887.answer: He is climbing down a narrow path.

4888.about: A blonde young woman in a white sundress walks barefoot along the wet sand at the edge of the sea; shallow waves wash over her bare feet and she leaves footprints behind her; the camera pulls back to show a long line of people walking barefoot on the same shoreline.

phrases.en: to wear a plain white sundress

4888.question: What is the woman in white doing?
4888.answer: She is leading the crowd along the shore.

4889.about: In a bright white photo studio a young woman spins around on a black office chair, laughing; two people beside her point and turn; the camera rises to show dozens of people turning and stepping on a large circular white platform ringed with potted plants, sofas and stools.
4889.question: What is the woman in white doing?
4889.answer: She is spinning on a stool.

4890.about: A rainbow-striped spinning top spins on the hexagonal paving of a city park while a teenage boy circles around it with one leg swung out; more and more people join in, running in a wide ring around the spinning top while the city skyline glows behind them at sunset.
4890.question: What is the boy circling?
4890.answer: He is circling a spinning top.

4891.about: On a sunny university lawn a blonde student in a white crop top leans far to one side towards the camera and laughs; her friends lean the same way beside her; the camera pulls back to show dozens of students on the grass all leaning sideways in the same pose, with big shade trees, walkways and university buildings behind them.

phrases.en: to rise high above the trees

4891.question: What are the students doing?
4891.answer: They are leaning to one side.

4892.about: A first-person ride down a water slide: bare legs in colourful swim shorts race feet-first through a blue chute past palm trees and a bright sky, then down a green flume into a burst of white water; the shot ends on the whole waterslide tower above a busy pool.

phrases.en: to laugh on the water slide

4892.question: What is the man wearing?

4893.about: A young woman in a navy T-shirt sits smiling in the stands of a baseball stadium; the camera pulls back over row after row of seated fans in caps and team shirts, past a packed lower tier, and rises into a wide shot of the whole bowl filled with spectators to the very top.

phrases.target: the woman in the car T-shirt
the woman in the car T-shirt
the man in the green jersey

4893.question: How full is the stadium?
4893.answer: The stadium is crowded with spectators.

4894.about: In a school sports hall a teenage boy in a grey shirt stands motionless on the centre line of the basketball court; the camera pulls back and more and more students appear standing in the same frozen pose, until an aerial view shows the whole hall filled with rows of unmoving students.

phrases.en: to stand on the black line

4894.question: What are the students doing?

4895.about: A dense crowd stands on a paved city plaza in the evening sun; as the camera lifts, the crowd resolves into two enormous lines of people standing directly across from one another on either side of a wide empty strip of pavement that runs down the whole avenue between office buildings.

phrases.target: the woman with the hair clip

4895.question: Where are the people standing?
4895.answer: They are standing opposite each other.

4896.about: A group of friends crouches together in a circle on a sunlit cobbled square; a moment later everyone is running outward in every direction in front of a domed basilica, and the low sun throws a long dark shadow with sharp edges behind each runner on the pale stones.
4896.question: What are the people doing?
4896.answer: They are running across the square.

4897.about: On a city square a small group of friends huddles in a tight group hug with their arms around each other; passers-by walk over and wrap their arms around the outside, and more and more people keep attaching themselves until a large mass of people is pressed into one huge hug.

phrases.target: the woman with the black bag

4897.question: What are the people doing?
4897.answer: They are joining a big group hug.

4898.about: Gardeners in straw hats and work gloves lift large flat rectangular sheets of glass into a metal frame standing over a flower bed; sheet after sheet is slotted in side by side until the frame is completely clad, and the camera flies up through the trees to show a huge glass dome in the forest.

phrases.en: to bloom in a raised bed

4898.question: What are the gardeners doing?
4898.answer: They are fitting glass panels into a frame.

4899.about: A hand pulls a carrot out of dark garden soil and it comes up as long as an arm; next two gardeners heave out a white radish taller than they are, with a mass of roots hanging off it; finally a whole group of gardeners lifts a full-grown tree straight out of the ground in a back garden.

phrases.en: to wear her hair in braids

phrases.target: the man in the dark hat

4899.question: What are the gardeners doing?
4899.answer: They are lifting an enormous tree.

4900.about: In a sunny back garden a wooden barrel rolls across the grass towards two onlookers; then a folding table with bats and balls appears, then a shopping trolley loaded with grocery bags; finally a very tall neat pile of wooden pallets stands on the lawn and topples into a scattered heap.

phrases.en: to spill groceries on the grass

4900.question: What is the tall stack doing?
4900.answer: The stack is collapsing into a heap.

4901.about: Seen from the top of a pale sea cliff, a woman dives head first off the edge into deep blue water under a blue sky; the sea below shades from turquoise to dark blue, and one after another more people leap off the cliff and hit the blue surface, leaving rings of white foam.

phrases.target: the woman in the black bikini

4901.question: What are the friends doing?
4901.answer: They are diving into the blue sea.

4902.about: Swimmers splash and laugh in a calm blue lake; behind them a long dark grey military submarine rises out of the water with its conning tower streaming water, and then a humpback whale breaches beside it and throws spray over the swimmers.
4902.question: What is the whale doing?
4902.answer: The whale is leaping out of the water.

4903.about: An aerial shot looking down on a wide, sunlit paved plaza in front of a glass building. At first single people walk across the tiles in every direction, casting long shadows. More and more people arrive, and the loose scattering turns into a dense mass that packs together in the middle of the square until the paving is barely visible.
4903.question: What are the people doing?
4903.answer: They are crowding into the middle of the square.

4904.about: Three shots of people and objects held up in precarious positions. A young man in black walks a slackline strung between two trees in a park, arms out to keep from falling. Then a very tall stack of wooden chairs balanced one on top of the other sways against a blue sky. Finally a group of men in black kit build a human tower, standing on each other's shoulders several levels high.
4904.question: What is the group of men doing?
4904.answer: The men are forming a human tower.

4905.about: Four shots of long structures reaching out over a distance. A workman in a blue shirt holds a telescopic aluminium ladder that pulls out to full length in front of a wooden fence. A red fire engine in a city street has its aerial ladder run out high into the sky. A crane boom stretches diagonally across a hazy construction site at sunset. Last, two steel bridge arches reach out from opposite cliffs across a red rock canyon with a river far below.
4905.question: What is the man holding?
4905.answer: He is holding an aluminium ladder.

4906.about: A garden party set-up on a mown lawn behind a wooden fence. First a colourful inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass. Then a white party tent with window panels stands square on the lawn, its cloth roof stretched over a centre pole and weighted at the foot. A purple and yellow inflatable arch stands over the grass, then sags and folds flat as the air goes out of it, and a large inflatable slide collapses in the same way.
4906.question: What is happening to the tent?
4906.answer: The tent is collapsing onto the lawn.

4907.about: Four shots of things shaking. A phone with a cracked screen buzzes on the boards of a wooden deck. A massage gun is pressed against a man's bare bicep and hammers into the muscle. A tracked machine's hydraulic breaker punches into gravel and asphalt, throwing up small stones. Finally a big black club speaker box hangs in a dark venue with dancers behind it, and a glass of water on the table in front of it ripples with the bass.
4907.question: What is the massage gun doing?
4907.answer: It is pounding a muscular arm.

4908.about: Four shots of things being bent into a curve. Two hands hold a flexible white plastic strip over a wooden table and bow it into an S shape. Then two hands grip a thick grey branch of an apple tree, leaves attached, and pull it into an arc over a green garden. In a bright gym a girl in a leotard arches backwards until her hands reach the floor. Last, a heavy hydraulic press in a workshop presses a steel beam into a curve.

phrases.en: to bend into an S shape
to press down on a beam

4908.question: What is the girl doing?

4909.about: A young woman films herself in a packed street party at sunset, laughing into the camera with people pressed all around her. She climbs a green lamppost and pulls herself up above the crowd while people below film her on their phones. A wide shot shows the whole street filled with thousands of people facing the low sun. She grins into the lens, then stands raised above the crowd with her arms up while everyone below cheers with their hands in the air and confetti falls through the golden light.
4909.question: What is the woman doing?

4910.about: A young man in a packed football stadium films himself in the stands. His face is painted in two halves, blue-yellow and red, and a long striped team scarf in club colours hangs around his neck over his shirt. A wide shot shows the ring of the stadium full of fans with a flag being waved on a pole. He shouts and screams with joy, the fans around him leap up and hold a scarf overhead, and he ends hugging a friend and roaring at the camera.
4910.question: What is the man doing?
4910.answer: He is shouting at the camera.

4911.about: A blonde woman holds up a ring of keys in front of her face and smiles behind them. She pushes open the glass door of a small cafe that still has a CLOSED sign hanging on it and steps inside. She ties a grey apron behind her neck over her white shirt, then walks along the wooden counter past the espresso machine and the pastry display case, spreads her arms to show the room, and laughs with her hands raised in the empty cafe that is now hers.
4911.question: What is the woman putting on?
4911.answer: She is putting on an apron.

4912.about: In a wooden-floored dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands in front of a class of students in white suits, who all bow together. She then demonstrates for them: she raises one knee and drives a high kick out to the side while the students behind her copy her stance. She holds a wooden board out at arm's length towards the class, calls out an instruction, and finally takes a wide stance with both arms out as the students watch and follow.

phrases.en: to hold out a wooden board
to snap the board in half

4912.question: What is the instructor doing?
4912.answer: She is holding out a wooden board.

4913.about: Two young women stand facing each other on a park lawn at sunset, hands pressed together, laughing. In close-up one of them fastens a woven beaded band around the other's wrist and adjusts it. They then throw their arms around each other, one climbs onto the other's back and they spin around on the grass with the low sun behind them.

phrases.en: to give her friend a piggyback
to ride on her friend's back

4913.question: What is the woman in jeans doing?
4913.answer: She is giving her friend a piggyback.

4914.about: A young man sits on a bench in a city plaza between office towers, playing a wooden acoustic instrument with six strings, one hand on the fretboard, the other strumming over the sound hole. A runner in a race bib jogs past. Office workers with shopping bags stop and gather in a half circle around him, clapping and smiling; a toddler dances in front; two people hold up phones to film him as he keeps playing and singing.
4914.question: What is the young man doing?

4915.about: Five friends are on a sunny rooftop terrace with a city skyline behind them. Two of them laugh with an arm laid across the other's back, hand resting where the neck meets the arm. The group lines up side by side, each one's arm hooked over the next one's upper body, and walks forward together; a low shot catches their trainers on the tiles. They pull into a tight circle with hands on each other's backs, then line up again and jump into the air with their arms flung up.
4915.question: What are the five friends doing?
4915.answer: They are jumping into the air.

4916.about: A low camera close to the boards shows two two-wheeled pedal vehicles rolling side by side along a wooden seaside pier, a young man and a young woman pedalling and laughing above them. They hold the camera at arm's length for a selfie with the beach and palm trees behind. They get off, and on the pier she spins and he catches her; they hold each other by the railing, then stand together grinning at the camera with the sun setting over the sea.
4916.question: What are they riding?

4917.about: Two players in padded red and blue overalls and full-face masks face off on a sandy paintball field littered with spent capsules. They bump fists, then sprint apart behind paint-splattered wooden barriers. The red player crouches behind a board holding a paintball marker, then leans out, points the marker and fires. A pink burst of paint explodes across the blue player's chest; he drops to his knees with his hands up while the red player walks past with the marker at his side.

phrases.en: to shoot the man in blue

4917.question: What is the man in red doing?
4917.answer: He is shooting the man in blue.

4919.about: A campus club fair on a lawn: rows of tents, bunting and a stall under a red canopy with a hand-lettered sign. Three students with cameras hanging round their necks stand behind the stall table and wave a newcomer over. One of them holds out an old silver film camera; she takes it and raises it to her eye. In close-up a hand signs a form headed MEMBERSHIP on a clipboard with a blue pen. The three then lift their cameras over their heads and cheer.

phrases.target: the woman in the white hoodie
the man in the checked shirt

4919.question: What are the three students doing?
4919.answer: They are raising their cameras over their heads.

4921.about: Two young men with big backpacks walk a narrow rough path cut through a spruce forest on a hillside. A selfie shot shows one of them breathing hard; the path behind him is loose dirt and stones. They laugh and point at each other, then climb on over a stretch of the path knotted with tree roots and rocks. At the end they stand on bare rock at the top, drop their packs, and throw their arms up over a wide green forest valley.
4921.question: What are the two men doing?
4921.answer: They are hiking up a steep forest trail.

4922.about: A young man in a waistcoat and shirt opens the door of his flat and waves people in. He gathers their coats in his arms and hangs them on hooks in the hall. In the kitchen he slides two tall glasses of sparkling water across the counter towards the camera. At a candlelit table set with pasta, salad, bread and wine, the guests laugh together; he stands at the head of the table and lifts his glass to them.
4922.question: What is the host carrying?

4923.about: A blonde young woman in a white shirt and a black waist apron smiles at the camera inside a warm, candlelit restaurant. She walks through the dining room holding leather menu folders under one arm, passing seated guests and a bar. She reaches an empty wooden table, lays the menus down on the two chairs and gestures at the table with an open hand. A couple follows her in and takes the places she has shown them while she stands beside the table.
4923.question: What is the waitress carrying?

4924.about: A young woman in an oversized beige sweater stands on a city pavement beside a pastel coffee kiosk, looking down at her phone. She glances up at a man in a denim jacket and her face opens in recognition; both of them point at each other and start talking. They shake hands warmly next to the kiosk window, then stand facing each other holding takeaway coffee cups and carry on chatting.
4924.question: What is the woman looking at?
4924.answer: She is looking at her phone.

4925.about: A nurse in teal scrubs pushes a supply trolley down a bright hospital corridor while colleagues wave at her. At a bedside she holds a forehead thermometer to a middle-aged male patient's temple and reads it. She shakes out his pillow and slides it back behind his head, and he laughs. In close-up she winds a white bandage around his wrist above the drip line. Finally she holds up a small bottle of juice for him and he grins back at her.

phrases.en: to lie propped up in bed

4925.question: What is the nurse pushing?
4925.answer: She is pushing a supply trolley down the corridor.

4926.about: In a bright dental surgery a woman in teal scrubs reaches up and swings the big round examination lamp over a man lying back in the treatment chair. Wearing latex gloves she leans over him with a small round mouth mirror and looks at his teeth while he keeps his mouth open. A close-up shows a toothbrush with blue bristles brushing along his front teeth. She then holds a round hand mirror up so he can see, and finishes by giving a thumbs-up next to the mirror.
4926.question: What is the dentist holding?

4927.about: A tall stack of thick hardback volumes sits on a polished wooden table in front of floor-to-ceiling shelves of matching legal books. A woman with a low ponytail in a navy suit and white shirt smiles to one side. She stands behind the table and lifts a black leather briefcase onto it with both hands. Outside, seen from behind, she climbs the wide stone steps of a courthouse with loose papers under one arm and the briefcase in her hand. At the top she shakes hands with a man in a dark suit, smiling.
4927.question: What is the lawyer carrying?

4928.about: A metal bucket stands on the tiled floor under an open kitchen sink cabinet, catching drips from the pipework above it. A young man in blue dungarees and a white t-shirt bends down and switches on the headlamp strapped to his forehead. In close-up his hands put a red adjustable wrench on the nut under the sink drain and turn it tight, with the bucket still below. He reaches up and pushes the lever of the chrome mixer tap. In the last shot he stands at the worktop grinning at the camera, headlamp on, while clean water runs from the tap into the stainless steel sink.
4928.question: What is the man fixing?
4928.answer: He is fixing a leaking pipe.

4929.about: Seen from behind, a student in a grey hoodie with a backpack runs along a sunlit path across a university campus. He hurries down the aisle of a full lecture theatre towards the speaker at the lectern. A close-up shows his hand writing lines in blue pen in a spiral notebook, with a yellow highlighter and a laptop beside it. A stack of library books and a steaming paper coffee cup stand on a table between the shelves. In the last shot he stands up at his classroom desk with his fist in the air, a paper marked with a large red A on the desk in front of him, while the other students clap and cheer.
4929.question: Where is the student running?

4931.about: A woman in a checked tweed blazer and black trousers walks past a wooden lectern into a large panelled lecture hall with a full audience, a leather case in her hand. In close-up her hand draws a wide chalk arc on a green blackboard. She then stands at the board beside a big chalk drawing of a circle with a cross of axes and labelled arrows pointing outwards, touching it with a wooden pointer as she speaks. Another close-up shows her chalking a formula with a fraction and arrows next to the drawing. At the end she faces the hall with both arms spread wide, smiling, the labelled circle drawing behind her.

phrases.en: to stride into the lecture hall

4931.question: What is the woman pointing at?
4931.answer: She is pointing at the chalk diagram.

4932.about: A hand pats the lit TAXI sign on the roof of a yellow cab, with tall city buildings behind it. From alongside the moving car we see it driving down a wide avenue into a low sun, other traffic ahead. Inside, over the shoulder of the driver, a young woman in a flat cap, white shirt and dark waistcoat holds the steering wheel with one hand and turns it as she follows the car in front through the traffic. She then leans out of the open driver's window at the kerb, grinning at the camera, and finally raises her hand to the brim of her cap and tips it.

phrases.en: to laugh in the back seat

4932.question: What is the woman doing?
4932.answer: She is steering the taxi through the traffic.

4933.about: A young man in a light blue shirt and dark tie sits in the driver's seat of a city bus at a depot, both hands on the large black steering wheel. He turns the wheel as the bus rolls out; a low shot from behind the wheel shows the dashboard and the road ahead. Back inside, passengers sit in blue seats behind him while he keeps one hand on the wheel and presses a red button on the console, smiling and speaking towards the door.
4933.question: What is the driver holding?
4933.answer: He is holding the steering wheel.

4934.about: A woman in a pilot's uniform walks through a sunlit airport terminal pulling a silver suitcase. In the cockpit a hand reaches up to the overhead panel of switches. She then lifts a green headset with a microphone boom over her ears and settles it on her head under her cap. From behind, she flies the plane down the runway, and finally she faces the camera wearing the headset and gives a thumbs up.
4934.question: What is the pilot wearing?
4934.answer: She is wearing a green headset.

4935.about: A woman in a white captain's cap, navy jacket and rubber boots walks up a metal gangway in a marina. She takes hold of the big wooden ship's wheel of a boat, with white yachts and masts behind her. A close-up shows her finger touching a brass compass set into the console, its needle and marked dial clearly visible. She pushes a throttle lever as the boat moves over the water, then points ahead over the bow.
4935.question: What is the woman looking through?
4935.answer: She is peering through a pair of binoculars.

4936.about: A cook in a white jacket and tall white hat works in a professional restaurant kitchen: steel counters, a row of gas burners, shelves of pots, a knife rack and bottles of oil on the wall behind her. She tosses a pan over a burner and a tall flame rises; she drops green herbs into peppers and prawns frying in the pan; at the pass she arranges the food on a white plate with tweezers, tastes the sauce from a spoon, then looks up and speaks to the camera.
4936.question: What is the cook tasting?

4937.about: A young man in a denim apron works the griddle of an American diner with red booths behind him. He cracks an egg onto the hot plate beside frying eggs and pancakes, flips the pancakes with a spatula, and stacks them on a green-rimmed plate. Syrup is poured over a pat of butter on top of the stack. He then leans over the counter, eyes wide, and strikes the metal service bell with his palm to call the order away.
4937.question: What is the man ringing?

4938.about: On a sunny café terrace a young woman in a white shirt and striped apron carries plates between wooden tables where guests are sitting. A couple at a table laugh and raise their coffee cups. She walks to a table by the railing and sets down a plate of dessert. A close shot shows a hand writing an order in a spiral notepad with a pencil, next to a cappuccino and a jar of white flowers. She turns to the camera and smiles, a pencil stuck in her hair.
4938.question: What is the waitress carrying?
4938.answer: She is carrying plates of food.

4939.about: A young baker presses a ball of pale dough on a floured wooden table while low sun pours through the window behind him. A board of dough balls is slid towards the mouth of a glowing brick oven. He wipes his floury forehead with the back of his hand in front of the fire. A tray comes out full of croissants baked to a deep golden brown, and he holds a steaming round loaf with a golden crust towards the camera.
4939.question: What is the man holding?
4939.answer: He is holding a golden loaf.

4940.about: A young man in a red and white striped apron and a white cap stands behind the glass display counter of a butcher's shop, filled with trays of steaks, sausages and sliced meat. He holds a thick red steak up in front of a brass weighing scale and lays it on the tray. He folds brown paper around the meat on the white block, ties the parcel with red and white string, and hands it across the counter with a smile.

phrases.en: to tie the parcel with string
to lie on a brass scale

4940.question: What is the butcher doing?
4940.answer: He is wrapping the steak in brown paper.

4942.about: A young man in a dark blue dress uniform walks out of the sliding doors of an airport arrivals hall with a large black duffel bag slung over his shoulder. He grins and looks around, walks through the bright glass concourse past waiting travellers, and reaches a family holding a hand-coloured WELCOME HOME sign. He hugs the father while the mother and a young woman laugh and cheer, then lifts his peaked cap off his head as they crowd around him.

phrases.en: to wear a long cream coat
phrases.target: the woman in the cream coat

4942.question: What is the soldier carrying?
4942.answer: He is carrying a duffel bag over his shoulder.

4943.about: A young man in a striped knitted sweater sits with his eyes closed while a hand dusts powder onto his cheekbone with a make-up brush. He then stands on a film set lit by big softbox lamps, pulls a huge open-mouthed shocked expression twice while a crew member moves equipment behind him, and finally the crew - five people in dark clothes - line up and clap and cheer for him. He turns back to the camera beaming with his hands on his hips.
4943.question: What is the crew doing?
4943.answer: They are cheering for the young man.

4944.about: A red-haired young woman sits at a dressing-room mirror ringed with bulbs and touches up her lips. She stands and spins so the long pale-gold skirt of her dress flares out, then walks away down a dark backstage corridor holding the skirt up. A wide shot shows her alone in a spotlight on a big empty theatre stage seen from the dark auditorium. Back in close-up she is handed a bunch of red roses, holds them out towards the camera, then bows over them in front of a red velvet curtain.
4944.question: What is the woman holding?
4944.answer: She is holding a bouquet of red roses.

4945.about: A young woman in an oversized band T-shirt presses a pair of big headphones to her ears in a recording booth strung with warm fairy lights. She leans into a large studio microphone behind a pop filter and belts out a note with her eyes shut and her mouth wide open. A cut shows an older man at a mixing desk pushing the faders. She keeps singing with her arms flung out, then laughs and looks over at a screen where the man behind the glass is clapping.
4945.question: What is the woman doing?
4945.answer: She is singing into a microphone.

4946.about: A young woman in a cropped brown hoodie and matching sweatpants stands at the wooden barre of a mirrored dance studio, her long hair tied back in a ponytail that swings as she moves. She holds the barre and laughs, turns to face the mirrored wall, then drops to the floor into a low crouch with one leg extended, springs up into a jump with her knees tucked, spins with her back to the mirror, and finishes facing the camera out of breath and smiling.

phrases.en: to lean on the wooden rail

4946.question: What is the woman wearing?
4946.answer: She is wearing a cropped hoodie.

4947.about: Two hands squeeze a tube of acrylic paint so a ribbon of yellow lands on a wooden board already loaded with blobs of blue, red, purple, orange and white. A young woman in paint-spattered dungarees works at a big canvas on a wooden easel in a sunlit studio, sweeping red and green strokes on with a brush, then stepping back to look at the swirl of colour. The camera passes behind the easel and comes round to reveal a finished painted face - a woman with green eyes and multicoloured hair - while the artist throws both arms in the air beside it.
4947.question: What is the woman painting?
4947.answer: She is painting a colourful portrait.

4948.about: A young woman in a green satin robe stands at a floor-to-ceiling hotel window with the outline of a whole city of tower blocks stretching away behind her under a pale sky. Holding an open bronze powder compact in one hand, she sweeps a make-up brush high on her cheekbone, then along the bridge of her nose and her brow, and finally under her chin, checking herself between strokes with wide eyes and an open mouth. At the end she lowers the brush, smiles at the camera and holds the compact up beside her face.

phrases.en: to apply powder with a brush
to raise her eyebrows in surprise

4948.question: What is the woman doing?
4948.answer: She is applying powder to her face.

4949.about: Two walkers with big backpacks and trekking poles climb a rust-coloured pine forest path, sunlight coming through the trunks behind them. The trees thin out and they pick their way up a bare grey rock slope with a wall of snow-covered peaks opening up across the valley behind them. They pull themselves up the last stones onto a narrow rocky crest under a deep blue sky, and stand at the top looking out over a huge white mountain range, raising their poles above their heads.
4949.question: What are the hikers doing?
4949.answer: They are climbing a rocky slope.

4950.about: In a mirrored dance studio a young woman in a bright red crop top and short red skirt stands facing the camera with both hands planted on either side of her body just below her waist. Around her a young man in a grey T-shirt and black shorts and two other dancers copy the same position, hands flat on the sides of their bodies below the waist. The man steps up beside her, holds the pose with a serious face, and by the end both of them are laughing while the class keeps its hands in place.

phrases.en: to wear a ruffled red skirt

4950.question: What is the young man doing?
4950.answer: He is resting his hands on his hips.

4952.about: A hand pushes down a door handle and opens a flat door. A young man with a backpack and a rolling suitcase steps into a narrow hallway; a golden retriever jumps up at him and he crouches to stroke it. An older woman in an apron comes out of the kitchen and they hug for several seconds while the dog sits at their feet. The last shot is a bedroom with a warm lamp and a bookshelf, where he drops backwards onto the bed and lies spread out on the quilt.

phrases.en: to jump up at the man

4952.question: What is the young man doing?
4952.answer: He is lying on the bed.

4953.about: A young woman leans over a terracotta flowerpot standing on a bright white windowsill. The pot holds only dark soil and nothing has come up yet. She waters it with a small metal can, then waits, biting her lip and pressing her clasped hands to her mouth, staring at the empty soil with an anxious face. Then a tiny green sprout pushes up through the soil; her eyes go wide, she gasps and finally smiles and cups her hands around the pot.
4953.question: What is growing in the flowerpot?
4953.answer: A tiny sprout is growing in the flowerpot.

4954.about: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks away from the camera across a car park towards a modern hospital with a red cross sign, carrying tulips and a round balloon, with an ambulance parked at the side. She goes through the sliding glass doors, along a long white corridor past open ward doors, and pushes open the door of a patient room. Inside, a young woman in a hospital gown is sitting up in bed; she claps her hands and beams when she sees the flowers and the balloon.
4954.question: What is the woman in bed doing?

4956.about: A young woman with a large trekking backpack walks in through the open door of a hostel and up to the front desk, where a member of staff stands behind the counter in a small room lined with leaflets, posters and a drinks fridge. Next she is at a huge painted world map on the wall, laughing as she presses a small marker onto it. She then walks into a dorm room with wooden bunk beds and a locker, greeted by two other travellers on the bunks. Finally she steps onto a rooftop terrace at sunset where friends are sitting at a wooden table, and the group eats a big pan of paella together as the sun goes down over the city.

phrases.en: to go down over the city

4956.question: What is the traveller carrying?
4956.answer: She is carrying a big backpack.

4957.about: A three-tier montage of places to stay. A young backpacker with a big rucksack leans out of the doorway of a shabby wooden roadside place under a pink and blue neon HOTEL sign. Cut to a woman in a grey suit wheeling a silver suitcase out of a revolving glass door into a bright marble lobby, with the caption 150 EUR over her. Cut to an elderly man in a dark suit with a walking stick greeted by a uniformed doorman in front of a floodlit palace facade with a fountain, then walking through a chandelier-lit marble hall, caption 2,000 EUR.
4957.question: What is the old man doing?
4957.answer: He is walking with a stick.

4958.about: A price-ladder tour of homes. An old man in a cardigan stands at a garden gate and waves toward a battered wooden hut behind him, caption 10,000 EUR. Cut to a young couple walking up the path of a detached white suburban house with a black door and a mown front lawn. Cut to a woman in a cream suit opening the door of a modern architect house, then presenting a huge glass villa with a long black reflecting pool and fountain, caption 5,000,000 EUR.

phrases.en: to point at a run-down hut

4958.question: What is the woman in cream doing?
4958.answer: She is presenting a luxury villa.

4959.about: Three homes shown in turn. An old man in a flat cap holds the plank door of a small single-story wooden cottage with a tin roof and a stove pipe, a tall sunflower beside it. Cut to a couple in matching tan jackets walking hand in hand up the path of a white weatherboard cottage with a red front door and clipped hedges, then a blonde woman presenting the same row of cottages with an open arm. Cut to a woman in a white suit standing in the doorway of a black glass mansion behind a still reflecting pool with palm trees.

phrases.en: to lean out of a doorway
to pose by a reflecting pool

4959.question: What is the old man doing?
4959.answer: He is leaning out of a doorway.

4960.about: An arrivals hall at an airport. A red-haired woman in a mustard jacket wraps both arms tightly around a dark-haired woman and holds her close, eyes shut, beaming over her shoulder. Around them travellers wheel suitcases past under the yellow Arrivals sign. More family members close in until the whole group is holding each other in one long group cuddle, laughing and rocking together.

phrases.target: the woman with the black bag

4960.question: What is the red-haired woman doing?
4960.answer: She is cuddling a dark-haired woman.

4961.about: A living room with a balcony full of houseplants. A grey tabby house cat lies flat on a rug with its belly to the floor, eyes locked on a small grey toy mouse on the wooden floor in front of it. Its owner sits at a low table behind, watching open-mouthed and covering his mouth with excitement. The cat wiggles, springs forward at the toy, then settles on the floor with its paws crossed, looking straight at the camera while the man throws up his hands.
4961.question: What is the cat doing?
4961.answer: It is playing with a toy mouse.

4962.about: A foggy autumn forest floor covered in red and orange leaves. A bearded man in an orange beanie and a red checked jacket crouches and points at a deep hoof print in the mud, a pair of black binoculars hanging on his chest. He kneels behind a tree trunk, then raises the binoculars to his eyes in a close-up and scans the misty trees. He spots a stag with big antlers standing in the sunlit fog and lifts his camera to photograph it.

phrases.en: to point at a muddy footprint

4962.question: What is the man pointing at?
4962.answer: He is pointing at a muddy footprint.

4963.about: A bright empty room during a move, with flat-pack furniture parts, screws and cardboard boxes on the floor. A red-haired woman in dungarees sits on the floor gripping one hand in the other, squeezing her hurt finger and screwing up her face. She stands, shakes the hand out, then bangs her bare toe on the leg of the half-built table and hops. Later she carries a white wardrobe with a man, who ends up clutching his own arm while she grabs her foot again.
4963.question: What is the woman squeezing?
4963.answer: She is squeezing her sore finger.

4964.about: In a modern kitchen at dusk, a man in a denim shirt with a towel over his shoulder lifts a spoonful of tomato-vegetable soup from a pot on the stove, blows on it and tastes it, then holds the spoon out for the woman beside him, who leans in and tastes it too. She smiles and nods. He then brings a bouquet of flowers out from behind his back; she gasps in delight, and they step onto the balcony and hug in front of the city lights.
4964.question: What is the man giving the woman?
4964.answer: He is giving her a bouquet.

4965.about: A teenage boy in mint-green pyjamas stands in a tiled bathroom in front of a white washbasin with a mirror, a shower cubicle and a towel rail. He brushes his teeth with a blue toothbrush, leans over the basin and spits, then lathers his hands with soap and rinses them under the tap, splashes water on his face, dries his face with a small towel and smiles at the camera.
4965.question: What is the boy brushing?

4968.about: In a busy public office a young woman with long red hair stands at a service counter, gasps with excitement and picks up a small plastic card that has just been issued to her. She turns it over, reads it, then holds it up beside her face so the photo on the card and her own face are seen together, gives a thumbs up, and the people waiting behind her clap.
4968.question: What is the red-haired girl holding?
4968.answer: She is holding a card with her photo.

4969.about: At small round tables on the pavement outside a city cafe, an older woman with white hair sits reading a book and sipping a cup of coffee. A young man in a colourful shirt at the next table talks at her, waves his hands, leans over her book and finally holds his phone in front of her, but she never looks up from her page. He slumps back in his chair while a waiter passes behind them.
4969.question: What is the old woman doing?
4969.answer: She is reading a book at a cafe.

4971.about: Night scene in front of a floodlit domed capitol building: an officer in a white dress uniform hauls a rope and runs a red, white and blue flag up a tall pole while a huge crowd watches; the sky then fills with burst after burst of gold, red, white and blue fireworks over the dome, and the shot ends among the crowd waving small flags and sparklers and cheering.
4971.question: What is the officer doing?
4971.answer: He is hoisting the flag up the pole.

4972.about: At night outside a lit domed parliament building, an officer in white uniform raises a pale blue and yellow national flag up a white pole; the crowd below holds up matching flags and phone lights, fireworks fan out over the dome, and a young woman with her country's colours painted on both cheeks screams with delight in the middle of the flag-waving crowd.
4972.question: What is on the woman's cheeks?
4972.answer: She has patriotic face paint on her cheeks.
